options.label: Creating art, writing, design, or media

options.label: Helping, teaching, or advising people
options.detail: Supporting others, community work, healthcare, or coaching (Social-inspired)

options.label: Leading projects, starting initiatives, or pitching ideas
options.detail: Business strategy, selling, debating, or organizing teams (Enterprising-inspired)

options.label: Organizing information, managing schedules, or detailed processes
